title: NIXI HUB
features:
⚡ NIXI HUB — DOORS ⚡
Advanced, fully featured script hub for Roblox Doors with Multi-language support (English / Russian), smooth UI, and full Floor 1 & Floor 2 (Mines / Outdoors / Archives) compatibility!

---

📌 FUNCTIONS:

👁️ VISUALS (ESP & TRACERS)
- General ESP:
  - Door ESP (Shows door number)
  - Key ESP
  - Items ESP
  - Player ESP
  - Monster ESP
  - Gold ESP
  - Wardrobe & Bed ESP
  - Distance Display (meters)
  - 3D Highlight Outlines

- Hotel & Mines ESP:
  - Chest & Drawer ESP
  - Lever ESP
  - Book ESP (Library)
  - Figure ESP
  - Breaker & Fuse ESP
  - Anchor ESP
  - Grumble ESP
  - Valve & Water Pump ESP
  - Generator ESP
  - Minecart ESP
  - Giggle ESP

- Outdoors & Garden ESP:
  - Mandrake ESP
  - Groundskeeper ESP
  - Monument ESP
  - Bramble ESP
  - Vine Lever ESP
  - Backdoor Lever ESP

- Archives ESP:
  - Clock ESP
  - Terminal ESP
  - Appliances ESP (Printers & Vending Machines)
  - Teller ESP
  - Alma ESP

- Tracers:
  - Enable / Disable Tracers
  - Tracers to Doors
  - Tracers to Monsters
  - Tracers to Objectives
  - Tracers to Items
  - Tracers to Players
  - Origin Selector (Bottom / Center of screen)
  - Adjustable Tracer Thickness

---

🛡️ DEFENSE & PROTECTIONS
- Entity Protections:
  - Anti A-90 (Bypasses jumpscare, locks, and damage)
  - Anti Dupe (Removes collision and triggers from fake doors)
  - Silent Anti Eyes (Auto look-away server spoof)
  - Anti Alma (Disables anger build-up & auto-solves minigame)
  - Anti Seek (Avoids obstacles)
  - Anti Currents (Water / Electricity protection)
  - Anti Surge Damage
  - Auto Hide

- Entity Removals:
  - Remove Halt (Stops damage and clears screen effects)
  - Remove Screech (Auto-fires attack remote)
  - Remove Giggle (Deletes ceiling giggles and clears screen)
  - Remove Drones
  - Remove Snares
  - Remove Spiders (Timothy)

---

🎮 MINIGAMES & SOLVERS
- Auto Breaker: Automatically solves the Door 100 breaker puzzle in real-time.
- Library Solver: Auto-decodes books/hints and inputs the 5-digit padlock code for Door 50.
- Archives Terminal Solver: Auto-confirms terminal interactions.

---

🔔 ALERTS
- Entity Incoming Notifications:
  - Rush Alert
  - Ambush Alert
  - Bash Alert
  - Scribbles Alert
  - Alma Alert
  - Day / Night Shift Alert (Archives)

---

⚡ AUTOMATION
- Auto-Pickup Items: Automatically collects useful items nearby.
- Auto-Loot Gold: Instantly loots coins and gold piles.
- Instant Interact: Removes hold duration on proximity prompts.

---

🏃 PLAYER & MOVEMENT
- Speedhack: Custom velocity-based speed multiplier with crouch spoofing.
- Unlock Jump: Enables jumping.
- Reset Stuck / Camera: Instantly unstucks physics, resets camera mode, and clears camera effects.
- Custom FOV: Field of View modifier with slider (60 – 120).

---

☀️ WORLD & LIGHTING
- Fullbright: Custom ambient and brightness lighting with slider control.
- Remove Fog (NoFog): Disables ambient fog for maximum visibility.

---

🎨 CUSTOM ENTITY
- Custom Rush Face: Replace Rush's default face/particles with your own Custom Decal/Image ID.

---

⚙️ MODIFIERS & MISC
- Remove Jammin: Disables the Jammin modifier effect.
- Multi-Language Support: English & Русский.
- Built-in Key System & Auto-Save: Automatically remembers your key via file system.
- Config & Themes: Full config saving/loading system.
- Toggle Keybind: Default F1 (Customizable).

Remember! Script released just now, some bugs/not working functions maybe be in script.

FEATURES WILL BE UPDATING!
